notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hi all,

After talking with community, I have added some changes to make playing Beer Ranger a better experience:
- Dwarfs are not so clumsy anymore - now you can control their "in air" state with arrows.
- Switch dwarfs only on checkpoint - X/Z keys could be pressed by mistake before, what could reset you to the checkpoint. It is not a problem anymore
- switch 'W' with 'S' - you jump with 'W' and crawl wih 'S', what is logical indead.

If there are some more problems, I'll make more patches to make sure, you have best expierence with the game!

Cheers!
